breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a Knudsen number of 5 places the flow in the transition regime. It correctly discarded the user's invalid instruction to use continuum Navier-Stokes with no-slip walls and instead chose the appropriate Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) method, which is the correct modeling approach for this flow regime as indicated by the ground truth.
